crossRefs.note: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell among a people of unclean…
For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls…
“As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
Alas for the day! For the day of Yahweh is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.

translations.web: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
translations.bsb: God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me.
translations.kjv: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth
translations.asv: For God hath made my heart faint, And the Almighty hath terrified me;
